conditions: to sustain the AI industry's commitments

from_speaker: roughly twice the size they are today
our_interpretation: Read business size as revenue, following the surrounding discussion of revenue growth and compute commitments.
Assess each company separately using comparable revenue measurements around June 2026 and subsequent annual checkpoints.
The first checkpoint is June 8, 2027. Use December 31, 2030 as the latest possible endpoint.

The testable conditional antecedent is a material shortfall from that growth path while the relevant commitments remain.

criteria.support_condition: A material shortfall from approximately annual revenue doubling occurs and financial evidence shows that the resulting growth shortfall prevents the relevant commitments from being funded.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Either company materially misses the approximate doubling path yet demonstrably sustains its relevant commitments through adequate operating resources and financing.
